blockers.quote: People cross that bridge from Mexico twice a week to sell theirs (c05).
blockers.why: Row c05 quotes a single donor (Genesis) who donates twice a week, and the claim in claims.md specifies "some twice a week". Stating "People cross that bridge from Mexico twice a week" overstates scope by turning an individual case and regulatory ceiling into a general frequency for all crossers.
blockers.fix: People cross that bridge from Mexico to sell theirs, some twice a week (c05).

keep.quote: In mice, the spaces between brain cells open up by about sixty per cent during sleep, and the waste washes out faster (c12). Sleep is when your brain takes the trash out. Yours hasn't in a month.
It's true. In 2022, brain cells in a dish, wired to the old bat-and-ball video game, began to get better at it within five minutes (c19). So a whole brain for eight hours is a bargain.
In rats, the day's activity replays in sleep, faster than real time (c14).
